supersedes.reason: v1's sole complete schedule was attempted but no Plan Rows were accepted; the transport fix requires a separately budgeted fixed check and one complete, unchanged schedule

transport_check.acceptance: ordinary EXPLAIN FORMAT JSON output parses as exactly one top-level Plan Rows value that is a nonnegative integer
transport_check.use_of_result: parser/transport acceptance only; numeric Plan Rows is neither persisted nor used for truth comparison, metrics, selection, tuning, query filtering, or schedule changes
transport_check.failure: stop before the 30,000-call evaluation schedule; retain only sanitized failure class

evaluation.deployment_schedule: each of Empty, frozen B2 and frozen B3 on every official test query in ascending source_index order
evaluation.estimate: ordinary EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON), top-level Plan Rows
secondary: mean absolute natural-log error on strictly positive estimate/truth pairs
evaluation.paired_nominal_pess: per-query Q1 differences; identical frozen sets are deduplicated and therefore identical observations/ties
evaluation.missing_or_invalid: retain an unresolved row; no fallback to pre-clamp or Plan Rows from another path

boundary: No selection/metric/accuracy use of the transport-check result. The full evaluation consumes only the immutable valid-frozen sets and the complete official test workload/truth; no post-outcome resource selection, tuning, calibration, or claims about unseen templates.
